subject: USSF NSIC - COSMOS AAS - MRAS
description: The U.S. Space Force's National Space Intelligence Center (NSIC) has a requirement for a vendor to furnish SMEs with deep domain knowledge of space intelligence, S&TI (Scientific and Technical Intelligence), and related disciplines to augment NSIC's organic teams. Support shall focus on achieving measurable outcomes aligned with NSIC's vision of providing progressive, predictive, and pioneering intelligence to outwit adversaries.

subject: GSA PBS - HOTD Metering Data Collection System with Billing - MRAS
description: The GSA Heating Operation and Transmission Division (HOTD) is a historic district energy system in Washington, D.C., that supplies steam and chilled water to dozens of federal and quasi-federal buildings. GSA PBS has a need for a contractor to provide software to generate reporting and billing functions for meter data, interface between HOTD and GSA servers, and maintain and operating billing and server networks.
